_comment: The Library's items, in shelf order. ONE list: build.js renders the shelf on /library/ from it AND generates a reader page per item at /library/read/<id>/. Adding an item is an entry here plus its files in library/items/ - nothing else. The build checks every file and thumb exists.

items.title: Nitnem Santhiya Pothi
items.note: Nitnem, set out for santhiya, from Adi Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji and Sri Dasam Guru Granth Sahib Ji.

items.title: Gurmukhi Baal Updesh
items.note: Gurmukhi from the beginning, for children: the letters, the matras, and writing them.

items.title: Kirtan Sagar
items.note: Shabads for the tanti saaj classes.
